name: Architecture standards file
description: Add an architecture.md standards file that prompts Claude to consider operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability factors when making architectural decisions. Derived from AWS Well-Architected Framework principles but presented generically to apply to any project type (CLI tools, web apps, mobile, libraries - not just cloud deployments).

userStories.title: Create architecture.md standards file
userStories.description: As a developer, I want architectural considerations documented as a standards file so Claude can reference them when making design decisions
acceptanceCriteria: Contains 6 sections: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance, Cost, Sustainability
Each section contains questions to consider, not checklists to fill
Generic framing (not AWS-branded) but cites AWS Well-Architected as source
Under 1,500 tokens to fit standards budget
Includes 'When to Read This Standard' section

userStories.title: Add to prompt.md standards table
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the architecture standard referenced in prompt.md so Claude knows when to read it
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md 'When to Read Standards' table includes architecture.md
Mapped to work types: system design, new services, infrastructure decisions

userStories.title: Link from FADE.md
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the architecture standard listed in FADE.md so it's discoverable
acceptanceCriteria: FADE.md Standards table includes Architecture row

pillars: Operational Excellence - deployability, observability, incident response
Security - identity, access control, data protection
Cost - efficiency, waste reduction, scaling economics
technicalNotes.notIncluded: PRD schema changes were considered but rejected as over-engineering. Use technicalNotes for PRD-specific architectural constraints.
